svg.title: A zdb tree split: files drawn at their key range, the straddling files shared by both trees until each compacts its half
svg.desc: One tree of the orders table grows past 10 GiB and splits at its median key. Files entirely left of the key stay in tree 1, files entirely right move to tree 2, and files that straddle the key are listed under both trees, shown two-tone inside a dashed outline. Tree 2 compacts its half of a shared L1 file into L2 and drops its reference; then tree 1 does the same; the file, referenced by neither, is deleted.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
